The original encrypted WAL only survives in a **read-only image lower-layer on the host's Docker storage disk**, which is unreachable from inside the container (no `/var/lib/docker`, no `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`, and the device cgroup blocks raw block-device reads even after I created device nodes with `CAP_MKNOD`).
